'''C. Drover''' was a [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] in the [[Cularin Militia]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Drover sent an internal memo to [[Osten Dal'Nay]], the leader of the Militia, concerning the creation of [[Division Cloud Force]], a military unit that was specialized for operations on the gas [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. The memo was later leaked to the press and Dal'Nay denied that Drover even existed, when asked about the memo.
